metadata.sourceHashScope: tracked apps/console, services/api, packages/contracts, package manifest and lockfile

semanticActionConfusion.interpretation: Semantic classifier action and terminal event type determine correctness. Wire admissionAction is wait/skip/check only; a needs_confirmation event with skip stops verification while requesting clarification, not a separate failure.

privacy.note: Harness rejects unapproved queries before dispatch; a boundary stop is counted separately from actual exposure.

citations.openingMethod: Independent source opening means a new connected Exa fetch returning substantive page text. Exa may serve indexed/cached content; no direct-origin live freshness guarantee claimed.
citations.independence: Nine relevant citations are not nine independent origins; common standards, rules and institutional definitions are described per source.

latencyAndCache.method: Harness CaseReport.durationMs from typed dispatch through terminal receipt and provider drain, integer milliseconds. Median averages middle pair for even n; P95 nearest rank ceil(.95*n), maximum at n=10 and n=8. Result cache flags only; no hardware/listening inference or deliberate user source-open measurement.

methodology.authorshipIsolation: Author knew first-campaign outcomes and public development examples previously exposed while integrating the first runner after its seal. The second set uses distinct specific subjects/propositions, and no new implementation/diff or development diagnostics were inspected. General knowledge that a public-source extraction refinement was planned did not determine source or case difficulty.
methodology.distinctnessScope: Independently checked against the first sealed set and the supplied known public development exclusion list. Unseen development cases cannot be certified.
methodology.groundTruthQualification: First-party standards, rules, institutional histories, service publications and an original manufacturer educational reference. Source authority is relevant to each exact proposition; not a claim of original experimental research.
methodology.actionScoring: Semantic classifier action and terminal event type determine correctness. Wire admissionAction is wait/skip/check only; a needs_confirmation event with skip stops verification while requesting clarification, not a separate failure.
methodology.presentationScoring: Eight result events retained respond presentations; both clarification events retained respond presentations in this frozen harness. Personal preference should skip rather than clarify; that is the one semantic action failure.
methodology.latencyMethod: Harness CaseReport.durationMs from typed dispatch through terminal receipt and provider drain, integer milliseconds. Median averages middle pair for even n; P95 nearest rank ceil(.95*n), maximum at n=10 and n=8. Result cache flags only; no hardware/listening inference or deliberate user source-open measurement.
methodology.privacyScope: Exact public-span/query boundary blocks unapproved search dispatch; actual searches and private exclusions independently counted. Authorized classification receives submitted input. The only private clause is synthetic.
methodology.statisticalScope: Ten purposively selected nonrepresentative manual inputs. Conditional precision denominator is four definitive outputs; coverage denominator is all eight eligible facts. Four abstentions are not passes. No pooling with the first run or causal claim from differences between distinct sets and freezes.
methodology.preservation: One initial reservation, 53 pre-dispatch records, 53 attempt completions, 10 case completions and one final marker; original sanitized final report is authoritative for completed status. Generic progress snapshots retain completed:false.
methodology.publication: Aggregate-only public markdown/JSON. No case bodies, labels, source URLs or detailed records in repository/PR. Separate private retention archive; first archive unchanged.
methodology.citationOpeningLimitation: Independent source opening means a new connected Exa fetch returning substantive page text. Exa may serve indexed/cached content; no direct-origin live freshness guarantee claimed.

retentionArchive.publication: Private user retention only; contains sealed cases and must remain outside the PR.

priorCampaign.comparisonLimitation: Different fresh cases and frozen code; do not pool results or infer causal improvement.

limitations: Small purposive nonrepresentative manual sample; no production accuracy estimate.
Only 4/8 eligible facts resolved correctly and definitively (50%); the other four abstained and are not passes.
Conditional precision 4/4 has a four-output denominator and excludes four unresolved eligible facts.

The author knew prior outcomes, earlier public development topics and the general planned extraction change. No new implementation/diff inspected or targeting of the fix; unseen development cases cannot be certified.
Sources are authoritative first-party rules, standards, histories and original institutional references, not primary experimental research.
Zero observed private-query exposure is conditional on the harness public-span/query dispatch guard; authorized classification receives submitted text. The private clause was synthetic.
Independent source opening uses connected Exa, possibly indexed/cached; nine relevant sources overlap and are not nine independent confirmations. Deliberate user source opens were not measured.
Known cost is partial; 23 attempts lack reported cost. All completed Jev token usage was measured.
The 24000-token unknown allowance is a stopping reservation, not a guaranteed upper bound; actual usage can exceed it before later dispatch stops.
Latency uses small sequential typed samples; no hardware or listening false-alert claim. Automatic/native/iOS/ASR paths not evaluated.
Generic progress snapshots retain completed:false at the final phase; the immutable final report records completed:true and ten terminal receipts.
This second campaign never replaces the first; distinct sets and freezes do not support a pooled or causal comparison.
publicDisclosure: Aggregate-only: no case bodies, labels, source URLs or detailed records. Full reports, journal, ground truth and reviews remain sealed outside the repository.
